purpose: Check whether row-level, column-level, or sub-tensor exact residency can reduce DeepSeek4 expert payload below the current whole expert-role granularity before writing runtime source.

source_evidence.build_expert_mix_lines_observed: gate = build_lora_mm_id(ffn_gate_exps, cur_experts_in, selected_experts); up = build_lora_mm_id(ffn_up_exps, cur_experts_in, selected_experts); act = ggml_swiglu_split(gate, up); experts = build_lora_mm_id(ffn_down_exps, act, selected_experts); output is permuted and summed over full n_embd rows.
source_evidence.tensor_creation_lines_observed: ffn_down_exps dims are { n_ff_exp, n_embd, n_expert }; gate/up expert dims are { n_embd, n_ff_exp, n_expert }.
source_evidence.quant_block_lines_observed: QK_MXFP4 = 32 and block_mxfp4 is one exponent byte plus QK_MXFP4 / 2 quant bytes.

minimum_exact_payload_math.result: The current role-level topN payload accounting already uses the minimum exact whole-output payload for one selected gate/up/down expert role.

exactness_analysis.reason: SwiGLU consumes all n_ff_exp=2048 gate and up outputs for each selected expert. Omitting rows changes the activation vector and logits unless an approximate pruning rule is introduced.
The down projection contributes all n_embd=4096 output dimensions before the MoE weighted sum and residual path. Omitting output rows changes model math.

MXFP4 blocks quantize dot-product columns in QK=32 groups. A partial-column split would require exact decomposition and accumulation for every output row; it does not reduce the exact output set and adds transfer/kernel overhead. Omitting columns changes the dot product.
This is approximate/logit-changing. It may only be reopened with a separate correctness proof and fixed-text top1 validation, not as an exact payload-reduction route.

hard_bound_conclusion.why: Fine-grained exact row/column/sub-tensor residency cannot reduce required bytes below one complete selected expert role for gate, up, or down. Existing topN role-based bounds are already the minimum exact payload frontier for the current representation.
hard_bound_conclusion.next_executable_route: No source work from this route. Continue only with a new hard-bound artifact proving >10 tok/s with margin, or obtain explicit disk cleanup approval for full alternate GGUF empirical testing.
